name: cool-mode
title: Cool Mode
description: Sprays playful particles — circles, images or emoji — from the pointer while you press the wrapped element.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CoolMode } from '@/components/ui/cool-mode'
</script>

<template>
  <CoolMode>
    <button>Click Me!</button>
  </CoolMode>
</template>

props.name: options
props.description: { particle?, size?, particleCount?, speedHorz?, speedUp? } — see below. Changing them restarts the effect.

props.name: options.particle
props.description: "circle" for random-coloured dots, an image URL (http… or /…), or any text or emoji.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The element that emits particles while pressed (usually a button).
